question: How do that-expressions reach even the supreme principle?
premises: They are born of the coloring produced by the time-reckoning adjunct.
Set forth beginning with that, they are consciousnesses even in the supreme.
inference: Time-tinted that-talk carries consciousness-expression into the supreme itself.
uncertainties: Exact joint of the long bahuvrīhi.
plain_english: Thus, born of the coloring produced by the time-reckoning adjunct, set forth beginning with 'that' — consciousnesses, even in the supreme principle.
